name: nvm
description: SHA-256 fetched unauthenticated from the same nodejs.org host (no GPG despite one being published).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted source read supports this narrow assessment: nvm fetches SHASUMS256.txt from the same Node mirror and compares the archive hash, with no GPG signature verification.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact behavior or upstream configuration.
Where verification is delegated to an external framework/package, that implementation was not vendored and remains unresolved.
